description: A shell script managing database operations for sports live stream platform, including migrations, resets, status checks, and backups.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Outputs informational messages with green color.

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Outputs warning messages with yellow color.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Outputs error messages with red color.

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL server is accessible.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a SQL file against the database.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a table to track applied migrations.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a migration has already been run.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the result of a migration attempt.

methods.name: run_migrations
methods.description: Runs pending database migrations in sequence.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all tables and types to reset the database, with confirmation prompt.

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays current database status, including table counts and migration history.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a dump of the database for backup purposes.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage information and commands for the script.
